key_insight: Task transformation can turn open-ended LLM training into a self-verifiable RL problem, extending RLVR beyond domains with deterministic answers.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable training paradigm for improving LLMs on summarization, creative writing, and reasoning without relying on expensive human judges or reward models.
method: Recast open-ended tasks into proxy environments with built-in verifiable outcomes.
Use SpyRL self-play: agents get asymmetric information, perform the same task, and vote to identify a predetermined spy.
Treat correct spy identification as an automatic reward signal aligned with output quality.
evidence_signal: Experiments on text summarization, creative writing, and mathematical reasoning show SpyRL beats prior self-improvement methods on non-verifiable tasks and improves verifiable reasoning tasks.
watch_item: Proxy-task design must preserve alignment with the original task, since a verifiable reward can be easy to optimize while only loosely matching true task quality.
paper_title: From RLVR to RLSVR: Task Transformation Induces Self-Verifiable Rewards for Open-Ended LLM Self-Improvement
